recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
export COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
